title: The EU AI Act just changed everything for tech companies

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How will the EU AI Act reshape the balance between innovation and regulation in the next decade?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: It mandates strict transparency for high-risk AI, like facial recognition and automated hiring systems, forcing tech firms to rethink deployment.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: This could slow progress, but it also protects citizens from biased algorithms and mass surveillance, which have already caused harm in some regions.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Engineers are building explainable AI models and using federated learning to comply without sacrificing performance or privacy.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: With clearer rules, we may see more trust in AI, leading to broader adoption in healthcare and education, where accuracy and fairness are critical.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future will see a new era of responsible innovation, where ethics and engineering finally walk hand in hand.

video_cue: A split screen showing a tech company's data center and a European parliament debating AI legislation.
